pages.note: PAR replaces Glory throughout. win_probability on games is always null -- no pregame rating model exists yet. A handful of very-early-season team-seasons (2026, teams with 0 games played) carry an empty unit_carousel rather than fabricated metrics.

Design decisions (2026-09-01): frame_profile is a fixed global LINE/BOX/SKILL grouping plus its own ST bucket (not folded into the other three); home_state/transfer_tier are per-player fields, no team-level geographic/transfers block. A HYBRID or unresolved-position player is not forced into one of the 4 frame buckets (would misstate their frame) but still appears in by_position_group and players[] -- see BIG_TODO for the exact count this affects per team-season. eligibility_remaining/eligibility_seasons/redshirt_* are a best-effort model (4/5-year NCAA clock), not verified compliance-office data.

par/games_played/total_production/avg_production/season_components are populated for 2019, 2021-2025 (run build_player_par_season.py after the PAR export). Null on seasons with no PAR export (2010-2018, 2026) and for positions with no recorded box-score production (OL, ST).

Bio & Background tab only -- Season Stats/Advanced Analytics stay client-side mock data. Keyed on this file's own person_id, never player_stats_2025_enriched.json (confirmed stale for at least one player). rating.available:false with every other rating.* field null for a player with no recorded production (most OL/ST) -- games[].par is 0.0 in that case, never null. spotlight is null for a player who has not played yet this season (not addressed explicitly by the spec's spotlight block, but the only sane behavior given rating already treats zero-production as a first-class state).
